svg.title: Figure 3. Paired differences for five metrics
svg.desc: Eight paired differences between modes for lives lost, win rate, final wave, leaked threat fraction and penetration, each with a 95% cluster-bootstrap interval.

g.text: Figure 3. Paired differences for five metrics
N = 150 held-out seeds x 5 styles x 6 modes = 4500 games; primary population 614 units (static game reached wave 5)
Lives lost (a lost game counts as 20)
difference in lives lost (a lost game counts as 20)
difference in win rate (share of games won)
Leaked threat as a fraction of spawned threat
difference in leaked threat as a fraction of spawned threat
difference in mean path progress of enemies (penetration)
Paired differences between modes (first minus second) over seeds, with 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals; the marker shows the
first mode of each pair. No p-values are computed for these estimates.
